titles.ja: 魔法少女リリカルなのは
titles.th: สาวน้อยจอมเวทย์ นาโนฮะ

title.ja: それは不思議な出会いなの?
title.en: That`s a Mysterious Meeting, Is It Not?
title.x-jat: Sore wa Fushigi na Deai na no?

1.overview: When Takamachi Nanoha, a 3rd grader elementary school girl, finds a wounded ferret and takes care of it she finds out she has magical powers and helps it fight a monster that attacked it.
1.summary:
Nanoha Takamachi has a very ordinary life as a third grader at Seishou Elementary School. She lives with her parents who run a cafe, and her older brother and sister. On the way home from school one day, she and her friends Arisa and Suzuka find an injured ferret in the park. This ferret is actually Yuuno, a young mage from another world.
Source: Amazon

title.ja: 魔法の呪文はリリカルなの?
title.x-jat: Mahou no Jumon wa Lyrical na no?

2.overview: After Nanoha transformed into a magical girl she and Yuuno fight the Jewel Seed and win. Yuuno tells Nanoha about him, the Jewel Seeds and her new magical powers when a new Jewel Seed appears and they go fight it.
2.summary:
Her encounter with Yuuno gives Nanoha magical powers, and she succeeds in sealing the mysterious shadow that threatens them. Later, Nanoha listens to Yuuno describe his world and his magic. Just as she decides to help him search for the “Jewel Seeds,” they feel the resonance of one in a shrine.
Source: Amazon

title.ja: 街は危険でいっぱいなの?
title.en: The Town`s in a Lot of Danger?
title.x-jat: Machi wa Kiken de Ippai na no

3.overview: Nanoha is exhausted from living her life as a normal girl during the day, and her magical girl life at night, but she has managed to get five Jewel Seeds. When a boy on her father's soccer team activates a Jewel Seed, it is up to Nanoha to save the town.
3.summary:
Nanoha leads a double life as an ordinary grade-schooler by day, and a mage by night. Feeling tired, she decides to take a day off from searching for Jewel Seeds, and goes to cheer on the soccer team coached by her father. Once again, she senses a Jewel Seed. Before calamity hits her neighborhood, Nanoha activates a new power of magic with her Raising Heart.
Source: Amazon

title.ja: ライバル!? もうひとりの魔法少女なの!
title.x-jat: Rival!? Mou Hitori no Mahou Shoujo na no!

4.overview: Suzaka invites Nanoha and Arisa over for a tea party. However, it is interupted for Nanoha when a jewel seed is activated. A mysterious black mage girl comes to claim the Jewel Seed, is she friend or foe?
4.summary:
Arisa and Nanoha are invited to tea at the Tsukimura home. All goes well until a cat finds a Jewel Seed in the garden and activates it. Nanoha and Yuuno set out to seal it, but they encounter another mage dressed in black. What is her purpose there?
Source: Amazon

title.ja: ここは湯のまち, 海鳴温泉なの
title.en: This Is Like a Town of Hot Water, the Uminari Hot Springs!
title.pl: To jest jak Miasto Gorącej Wody, Gorące Źródła Uminari!
title.x-jat: Koko wa Yu no Machi, Uminari Onsen na no

5.overview: Fate and her familiar Arf challenge Nanoha at a hot spring.
5.summary:
The Takamachi family and Tsukimura family go to an onsen together. Nanoha and the others were relaxing in the onsen, but Nanoha can`t stop thinking about the girl in black...Fate...who she met the day before. What is the destiny of the two magical girls when Fate`s familiar, Alf also appears and they fight once more?!
Source: Amazon

title.ja: わかりあえない気持なの?
title.en: Is it a Feeling I Couldn`t Understand?
title.x-jat: Wakari Aenai Kimochi na no?

6.overview: Arisa suspects that Nanoha is hiding something.
6.summary:
Nanoha is worried about Fate. Meanwhile, Arisa and Suzuka are worried about Nanoha. Nanoha is thinking about Fate while recalling how she met her two friends. Confronted by Fate for the third time while searching for a Jewel Seed, Nanoha tells Fate her name, but...
Source: Amazon

title.ja: 3人めの魔法使いなの!?
title.x-jat: Sannin Me no Mahou Tsukai na no!?

7.overview: Fate's mother, the real villain, is revealed just as the Time-Space Administration Bureau arrives.
7.summary:
Fate returns to her mother with the Jewel Seeds she has gathered. Nanoha begins to realize what she must do in her fight with Fate. As the two girls fight once more for a Jewel Seed, Chrono, a mage from the Time-Space Administrative Bureau appears before them.
Source: Amazon

title.ja: それは大いなる危機なの?
title.x-jat: Sore wa Ooi Naru Kiki na no?

8.overview: Nanoha joins with the Time-Space Administration Bureau. Yūno reveals his human form to Nanoha.
8.summary:
Nanoha and Yuuno are brought aboard the Administrative Bureau`s ship, Arthra. Lindy, the captain of the ship, reveals the truth about the Jewel Seeds and their capabilities. The Administrative Bureau takes over the problem of the Jewel Seeds and Nanoha and Yuuno`s response is...?
Source: Amazon

title.ja: 決戦は海の上でなの
title.en: The Decisive Battle Is to Be Over the Sea
title.x-jat: Kessen wa Umi no Ue de na no

9.overview: Nanoha ignores orders and tries to help Fate.
9.summary:
Nanoha and Yuuno continue their search for the Jewel Seeds from inside the Arthra. Fate and Alf hunt for the Jewel Seeds while evading the Administrative Bureau. In order to obtain the remaining six Jewel Seeds which have yet to be found, Fate takes a risk...
Source: Amazon

title.ja: それぞれの胸の誓いなの
title.en: These Are the Vows in Each of Our Hearts
title.x-jat: Sorezore no Mune no Chikai na no

10.overview: Arf is thrown out by Precia and joins Nanoha. Nanoha visits her friends and family, and sorts everything out.
10.summary:
Allowed a temporary leave from Arthra, a happy Nanoha is able to visit family and friends. Presea blames Fate for the failure in collecting the Jewel Seeds, which is the last straw for Alph. So Nanoha comes to a decision about the latest incident...
Source: Amazon

title.ja: 思い出は時の彼方なの
title.x-jat: Omoide wa Toki no Kanata na no

11.overview: Nanoha and Fate battle for all the Jewel Seeds, and Fate's origin is revealed.
11.summary:
Putting all her faith in her own magic, Nanoha challenges Fate to a final battle. During the confusion, Fate attacks Nanoha with all her strength. Yuno and Alph watch on, while Amy watches over Chrono. And the final result of the battle between the two of them is...!
Source: Amazon

title.ja: 宿命が閉じるときなの
title.en: This Is When Our Fates Are Sealed
title.x-jat: Shukumei ga Tojiru Toki na no

12.overview: In the final battle, the TSAB march on the Garden of Time.
12.summary:
Presea activates the Jewel Seeds, so she can attempt to open the door to the lost city of Al Hazard. Nanoha and Yuuno must accompany Lindy and Chrono to prevent this from happening. Meanwhile, Fate remains unconscious in the medical bay...
Source: Amazon

title.ja: なまえをよんで
title.x-jat: Namae o Yonde

13.overview: Nanoha and Yūno say their farewells to the TSAB and they both head home.
13.summary:
Now that the "Presea Testarossa Incident" has come to an end, Nanoha and the others can return to a peaceful life. As the days quietly pass, Nanoha thinks about Fate. Then one morning, Nanoha`s phone rings...
Source: Amazon
